violation_type.title: Critical Injury - Contact Parent (26 TAC §746.3607(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify the parents of children who required medical attention. The incident occurred at 9:00 am, and the parents found out about the incident when they picked up their children.

finding_variants.text: The operation failed to notify the parents of children who required medical attention. The incident occurred at 9:00 am, and the parents found out about the incident when they picked up their children.

Based on evidence obtained during the investigation, caregivers did not make a reasonable effort to immediately contact the parent of a child that has a serious injury that required medical attention.
A child's parent was not immediately contacted after a child in care obtained a head injury.
